record_title: A standard non-surjective Hausdorff self-isometry of the convex hyperspace of c0
provenance: Scientific sources and verification evidence are listed in RESULT.md and REVIEW.md.
limitations: The result is a counterexample mechanism rather than a classification. The full text of Zhou (2022), DOI 10.1016/j.jmaa.2022.126282, was not inspected, leaving a localized originality risk for an equivalent earlier construction; older hyperspace literature may also use different terminology.
